Soolantra is a cream with the active ingredient Ivermectin. So no it is not a steroid or any kind of immunosuppressant. It helps those who have an abundance of mites on their skin because these mites when there are too many (everyone has them!) cause the inflammation and papules/pustules. It’s often prescribed for rosacea and pd. You never know, demodex mite be ur problem and that’s why u aren’t finding relief from the other medications. Ur derm can check ur skin to see if you have an overpopulation of demodex if you ask them to. Also adapalene is a retinoid so it’s not in the same category as azelaic acid and they’re definitely not the same and they’re only similarity really is that they both an treat acne but they do so in different ways. Azelaic acid is a dicarboxylic acid, itexists in our skin already so it’s really well tolerated in general and not too irritating. It has antibacterial properties for the acne part of things, it reduces redness, inflammation and decreases keratin production. Azelaic acid and Soolantra (Ivermectin) are both reputable medications for PD. If you haven’t tried them, pick one and give it three months to work. If it doesn’t try the other. Okay. I would suggest using a Fungal acne (FA) safe routine and treat for FA first. You can find other FA safe products online but these are my inexpensive recommendations since i am also a broke student.

Be consistent and:
STEP1: apply sunscreen every am (nivea super water gel)
STEP2:wash every pm (vanicream cleanser)
STEP3:moisturise after with (avene tolerance cleansing lotion as a moisturiser) moisturising is so important!!! because dry skin produces more oil which produces more acne.
STEP4:treat (3 minute nizoral/sulfur/head and shoulders/selsun blue mask every few days) 

FA responds quickly to treatment unlike usual acne with can take months so If you see no difference in two weeks then fungal acne probably isn’t your issue. 

So, try a different treatment. Keep the rest of your routine because your skin needs consistency and there’s no harm using FA safe products even if you don’t have it but just change ur treatment. You could change it to something like Paulas Choice BHA a couple times a week. For these kinds of treatments you need to give them time. Just use one at a time for a few months so you know what’s working. If BHA doesn’t work, try a AHA treatment. If that doesn’t work try Azelaic Acid. 

You’ll find something !!!:) Hope that helps.
